svg.aria-label: A long job in ELU: the agent starts a long test run as a job and ends its turn, the job keeps running, and when it ends ELU starts the session again by itself and the agent reports the result.
svg.title: A long job in ELU: the agent starts a long test run as a job and ends its turn, the job keeps running, and when it ends ELU starts the session again by itself and the agent reports the result.

g.text: No bot reviews the changes. Type @name to add one.
Run: elu jobs start tests -- npm run test:all
The full test run is long, so it runs as a job named tests.
My turn ends here. ELU starts me again when the job ends.

My turn ends here. ELU starts me again when the job ends.
The job ended with exit code 0. The full test run passed.
You ask for the full test run.
The agent wants to run it as a job. You allow it with y.
The turn ends. The job keeps running.
The job ends. ELU starts the session again by itself.
The agent reads the result and reports.
